title: Delivery & Pickup Services Pricing Note: Maintenance Delivery Discount on the Express Speed Charge
content:
The express speed charge of a Delivery & Pickup Services express order is the plan's express fee reduced by the maintenance delivery discount, and the discount applies only where the plan has no subscription or the subscription fee of the billing cycle in which the order was placed stands collected.

The maintenance delivery discount depends on the patient's prescription history in the 6 months up to the day the fee is booked, as the Prescriptions fill ledger shows it, counting refills dispensed and prescription pickups released by home delivery.

## Discount tiers

| Refills dispensed and home-delivery pickups in the 6 months | Discount on the express fee |
|---|---|
| 6 or more refills and 6 or more home-delivery pickups | 20 percent |
| at least 3 of each, but fewer than 6 of at least one of the two | 10 percent |
| fewer than 3 refills, or fewer than 3 home-delivery pickups | none |

Stated as a rule: 6 or more of both earns 20 percent; at least 3 of both, but fewer than 6 of at least one, earns 10 percent; anything less earns no discount.

## Combinations (hypothetical counts)

| Refills | Home-delivery pickups | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | 6 | 20 percent |
| 9 | 5 | 10 percent |
| 5 | 8 | 10 percent |
| 3 | 3 | 10 percent |
| 7 | 2 | none |
| 2 | 10 | none |

Pickups released at the counter, at the drive-thru or from a pickup locker do not count; only pickups released by home delivery do.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

On Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly (express fee $6.99), with the current cycle's subscription fee collected and a 20 percent discount, the express speed charge is 6.99 less 20 percent of it, 5.592. The speed charge is not rounded on its own; the express fee is rounded to the cent as a whole. With the current cycle's subscription fee not collected, no discount applies and the speed charge is 6.99. On Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery, a plan without a subscription, the discount applies whenever it is earned: 12.99 less 10 percent is 11.691.
